callables.name: field
callables.summary: get a field by its computed number
notes: NUMBER must be a non-negative whole number. Field 0 is the complete record; a missing field is an empty string.

callables.name: fields
callables.summary: get a computed inclusive field range
notes: START and END must be positive whole numbers. Original separators between the fields are preserved.

callables.name: fields-from
callables.summary: get fields from a computed position through the record end
notes: START must be a positive whole number. Trailing separators are preserved.

callables.name: fields-to
callables.summary: get fields from the record start through a computed position
notes: END must be a positive whole number. Leading separators are preserved.
Division by zero and non-finite results are errors.
A zero divisor is an error. The result has the sign of the dividend.

callables.name: n/round
callables.summary: round to nearest, halves away from zero

callables.name: n/fixed
notes: DIGITS must be a whole number from 0 through 100.

callables.name: n/clamp
callables.summary: limit a number to an inclusive range
notes: MIN must be less than or equal to MAX.

callables.name: s/repeat
notes: COUNT must be a non-negative whole number.

callables.name: s/replace
notes: An empty FROM inserts TO at the start.

callables.name: s/replace-all
notes: An empty FROM inserts TO at every character boundary.

callables.name: s/part
notes: DELIMITER must not be empty; POSITION must be a positive whole number. Missing parts are empty strings.

callables.name: s/before
callables.summary: take text before the first literal delimiter
notes: DELIMITER must not be empty.

callables.name: s/after
callables.summary: take text after the first literal delimiter
notes: DELIMITER must not be empty.

callables.name: s/slice
callables.summary: take Unicode characters from a 1-based start
notes: START must be positive; LENGTH must be a non-negative whole number.

callables.name: s/lpad
callables.summary: pad the left side to a Unicode character width
notes: WIDTH counts Unicode characters and must be a non-negative whole number. FILL defaults to one space and must be exactly one Unicode character.

callables.name: s/rpad
callables.summary: pad the right side to a Unicode character width
notes: WIDTH counts Unicode characters and must be a non-negative whole number. FILL defaults to one space and must be exactly one Unicode character.

callables.name: s/empty?
callables.summary: test whether a string is empty

callables.name: s/dquote
callables.summary: stringify and wrap in escaped double quotes

callables.name: s/squote
callables.summary: stringify and wrap in escaped single quotes

callables.name: s/unquote
callables.summary: remove matching quotes and decode backslash escapes
notes: Unquoted values are unchanged. Quoted values accept \\, \n, \r, \t, and an escaped enclosing quote.

callables.name: shq
callables.summary: stringify and quote as one shell-safe argument
notes: Unlike dq, prevents shell expansion of $, command substitutions, and other syntax.

callables.name: s/trim
notes: Exact affixes are removed at most once; empty or absent affixes leave that end unchanged.

signatures.summary: remove Unicode whitespace from both ends
remove one exact prefix and suffix

callables.name: s/ltrim
callables.summary: trim left whitespace or an exact prefix
notes: An exact prefix is removed at most once; an empty or absent prefix leaves the value unchanged.

signatures.summary: remove Unicode whitespace from the left

callables.name: s/rtrim
callables.summary: trim right whitespace or an exact suffix
notes: An exact suffix is removed at most once; an empty or absent suffix leaves the value unchanged.

signatures.summary: remove Unicode whitespace from the right

callables.name: csv/join
callables.summary: join values as one CSV record
notes: Fields containing commas, double quotes, CR, or LF are quoted; embedded double quotes are doubled.
A single empty field renders as "". The result has no record-ending newline.

callables.name: path/stem
callables.summary: extract the final component without its extension

callables.name: path/ext
callables.summary: extract the extension without its dot or an empty string

callables.name: path/dir
callables.summary: extract the directory or an empty string

callables.name: default
callables.summary: use a fallback when the value is empty or errors

callables.name: and
callables.summary: stop at the first false value

callables.name: or
callables.summary: stop at the first true value

callables.name: reg
notes: Regex literals preserve backslashes; quoted patterns require string escaping.

callables.name: re/part
notes: POSITION must be a positive whole number. Missing parts are empty strings.

callables.name: dt/to-unix
callables.summary: convert a datetime to Unix seconds
notes: Fractional seconds are preserved when representable as Number.

callables.name: dt/now
callables.summary: current UTC time at second precision

callables.name: dt/floor-s
callables.summary: floor to a local or UTC second

callables.name: dt/floor-m
callables.summary: floor to a local or UTC minute

callables.name: dt/floor-h
callables.summary: floor to a local or UTC hour

callables.name: dt/floor-d
callables.summary: floor to a local or UTC calendar day

callables.name: dt/diff
callables.summary: subtract the right datetime from the left

callables.name: du/d
callables.summary: convert fixed 24-hour days to a duration

callables.name: du/to-d
callables.summary: convert a duration to fixed 24-hour days

callables.name: ip/private?
callables.summary: test RFC 1918 IPv4 or fc00::/7 IPv6 ULA

callables.name: cidr/size
callables.summary: return the address count up to 2^53 - 1

callables.name: url/port
callables.summary: extract the port or an empty string

callables.name: url/query
callables.summary: extract the query or an empty string

callables.name: url/fragment
callables.summary: extract the fragment or an empty string

callables.name: url/query-get
callables.summary: return the first decoded value or an empty string

callables.name: url/query-has?
callables.summary: test whether a decoded query name exists

callables.name: semver/prerelease
callables.summary: return prerelease text or an empty string

callables.name: semver/build
callables.summary: return build metadata or an empty string

callables.name: uuid
notes: Accepts simple, hyphenated, braced, and URN forms; renders lowercase hyphenated.

callables.name: uuid/v7
notes: Generation order is preserved within one cho invocation.

callables.name: uuid/time
callables.summary: extract the timestamp from a UUID
notes: The UUID must be version 1, 6, or 7.

callables.name: ulid
notes: Accepts upper- or lowercase Crockford Base32; renders uppercase.

callables.name: ulid/new
notes: Generation order is preserved within one cho invocation.

callables.name: ulid/time
callables.summary: extract the timestamp from a ULID
insert a value as each step's first argument
insert a value as each step's last argument
